issues.title: Classify Lazurio Documentation in the Organization inventory
issues.question: Where should the public Lazurio Documentation repository live in the Human and Machine Organization inventory?
issues.impact: The repository needed one truthful local classification without changing its public GitHub owner or granting it Workspace runtime authority.
options: Register it as a runnable Workspace module with Team membership and a port lease.
Register it as a read-only productionspace repository while preserving Lazurio/documentation as the provider authority.

resolution.decision: Lazurio/documentation remains a public repository in the Lazurio GitHub Organization and is represented locally as productionspace/documentation in Human and Machine.
resolution.rationale: Documentation is a public production surface with its own Cloudflare publication gate. It is not a Team-owned Workspace application and therefore has no Launchpad Start action, runtime lease or port.
resolution.selected_option: Register it as a read-only productionspace repository while preserving Lazurio/documentation as the provider authority.
resolution.evidence: The reviewed Organization inventory was published; Organization Doctor, Lazurio synchronization and Launchpad readback confirmed the read-only productionspace representation.

issues.title: Confirm availability of advanced GitHub secret-scanning modes
issues.question: Can non-provider pattern scanning and validity checks be enabled for this public repository under the current GitHub Organization plan and policy?
issues.impact: GitHub secret scanning, push protection and Dependabot security updates remain enabled. The two additional modes are not available under the current Lazurio Organization plan.
options: Enable the advanced modes if the Organization plan exposes them and verify provider readback.
Keep standard secret scanning and push protection as the enforced baseline and document the advanced modes as unavailable.

resolution.decision: Keep the verified standard secret-scanning baseline and treat non-provider patterns plus partner validity checks as unavailable until the Organization plan changes.
resolution.rationale: Live GitHub readback identifies the Lazurio Organization as GitHub Free and both repository modes as disabled. GitHub's current product documentation makes these modes available to Organization repositories on GitHub Team with Secret Protection. The global recommended configuration is unenforced and is not evidence that the controls run on this repository.
resolution.selected_option: Keep standard secret scanning and push protection as the enforced baseline and document the advanced modes as unavailable.
resolution.evidence: GitHub REST readback on 2026-08-27 plus the current GitHub documentation for generic patterns and partner validity checks.

issues.title: Align local Wrangler runtime with the declared compatibility date
issues.question: Which reviewed Wrangler version should replace 4.92.0 so local Pages emulation supports compatibility date 2026-08-26?
issues.impact: Local Pages emulation now covers the declared compatibility date instead of relying only on Astro build and deployed-provider smoke.
options: Upgrade the pinned Wrangler version in a separate dependency PR and rerun build plus Pages emulation.
Keep 4.92.0 temporarily and treat CI plus a deployed preview smoke as the provider-runtime proof.

resolution.rationale: The reviewed version supports Node 22+, accepts compatibility date 2026-08-26 and keeps the existing Pages build and deployment contract unchanged.
resolution.selected_option: Upgrade the pinned Wrangler version in a separate dependency PR and rerun build plus Pages emulation.
resolution.evidence: The full build passed and Wrangler 4.127.0 served the generated Pages worker locally with 302 root redirect, 200 English page and exact content-index source commit.

issues.title: Triage dependency vulnerabilities reported on the default branch
issues.question: Which dependencies account for the 18 open GitHub vulnerability alerts, and which upgrades can be applied without breaking the pinned documentation stack?
issues.impact: GitHub reported 3 high, 9 moderate and 6 low dependency vulnerabilities during the Czech documentation push. The current gh identity received HTTP 404 when requesting alert details, so affected packages, reachability and fixed versions remained unverified.
options: Inspect the alerts with an identity that can read repository security events, then prepare a separate dependency-update PR with build and browser verification.
If GitHub's count is stale or refers only to unreachable development tooling, record the evidence and close or downgrade this issue without weakening the current security baseline.

resolution.decision: The 18 alerts are 17 Astro runtime advisories and one @astrojs/cloudflare adapter advisory; prepare one reviewed static-site upgrade instead of merging the individually incompatible Dependabot PRs.
resolution.rationale: Live GitHub API readback made the affected packages and patched versions visible. The existing Documentation is static and contains no Cloudflare runtime API usage, so removing the adapter is simpler and preserves its Pages deployment contract while allowing the patched Astro 7 family.
resolution.selected_option: Inspect the alerts with an identity that can read repository security events, then prepare a separate dependency-update PR with build and browser verification.
resolution.evidence: GitHub Dependabot alert readback on 2026-08-31; local Bun 1.3.14 frozen-install, content, build and Pages browser checks on the replacement branch.
